Label: NAICS Classifier (SUDOKN)
Description: The SUDOKN class for NAICS classifiers, asserted as a second type on the 13 NAICS Industry Classification nodes to align this graph with the SUDOKN manufacturing graph. Read the codes through md:naicsCode.

Label: 21 CFR Section
Description: A section of Title 21 of the Code of Federal Regulations, with its authority and full regulatory text.

Label: 21 CFR Part
Description: A part of Title 21 of the Code of Federal Regulations that groups related sections.

Label: CLIA Waived Analyte
Description: An analyte whose test is waived from routine regulatory oversight under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments.

Label: De Novo Authorization
Description: A De Novo classification request granting marketing authorization to a novel low-to-moderate risk device that has no valid predicate. A subclass of Regulatory Submission.

Label: Devices@FDA Catalog Record
Description: An entry in the Devices@FDA catalog, linking a marketed device to the submission and pathway under which it reached the market.

Label: Device Problem
Description: A device problem code reported on MDRs for a TPLC product code, with its report and event counts.

Label: Geocoded Facility
Description: An FDA-registered establishment whose registration address has been geocoded. A subclass of FDA Registration and Listing Record: each of the 9,120 facilities is also typed md:RegistrationListingRecord and geo:Feature, keeps all registration properties, and adds a point geometry, latitude and longitude, a normalized address, and the geocoder's source and confidence. Almost all are U.S. addresses; the other 16,012 registration records have no coordinates. Reach the NAICS industry of a facility through md:hasManufacturer and md:hasNAICSClassification (3,452 facilities have one).

Label: Humanitarian Device Exemption
Description: A Humanitarian Device Exemption record, covering a device intended to treat or diagnose a condition affecting a small patient population.

Label: IVD Home-Use Test
Description: An in vitro diagnostic test cleared or approved for home (over-the-counter) use.

Label: 510(k) Submission
Description: A premarket notification submission under section 510(k), by which a device is cleared for market on the basis of substantial equivalence to a legally marketed predicate device. A subclass of Regulatory Submission.

Label: MAUDE Adverse Event Report
Description: A Medical Device Report (MDR) from the FDA Manufacturer and User Facility Device Experience (MAUDE) system, describing a suspected device-associated death, serious injury, or malfunction. A subclass of Adverse Event Report.

Label: MDR Statistic
Description: A yearly count of medical device reports and events for a TPLC product code.

Label: MQSA Certified Mammography Facility
Description: A mammography facility certified under the Mammography Quality Standards Act. A subclass of FDA Data Record.

Label: Manufacturer
Description: A firm or establishment named on an FDA record, identified where possible by its FDA Establishment Identifier (FEI). The 10,432 manufacturers that carry a NAICS classification are also typed iof:Manufacturer.

Label: Medical Device
Description: A medical device, the hub entity that FDA records about the same product are attached to.

Label: NAICS Industry Classification
Description: A North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) industry, with its six-digit code in md:naicsCode, the NAICS version in md:naicsVersion, and the industry title in rdfs:label. The graph holds 13 NAICS 2022 industries (e.g., 339112 Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing), assigned to manufacturers and FDA product codes by the knowledge graph's own crosswalk, not by FDA. The same nodes are also typed sud:NAICSClassifier.

Label: PMA Supplement
Description: A supplement to an approved PMA covering a change to the device, its manufacturing, or its labeling. A subclass of Design Change.

Label: PMA Submission
Description: A Premarket Approval application, the FDA scientific and regulatory review pathway required for Class III devices. A subclass of Regulatory Submission.

Label: Patient Outcome
Description: A patient outcome code reported on MDRs for a TPLC product code, with its report and event counts.

Label: 522 Postmarket Surveillance Study
Description: A postmarket surveillance study ordered under section 522 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act. A subclass of FDA Data Record.

Label: FDA Product Classification Record
Description: The FDA classification record for a product code, giving its device class, regulation, review panel, and regulatory flags. A subclass of FDA Data Record. Its nodes (IRIs ending productcode/<code>) are separate from the FDA Product Code nodes (IRIs ending product-code/<code>); only 443 nodes carry both types, so join the two on the md:productCode literal. 1,589 of the 7,071 records carry a NAICS industry through md:hasNAICSClassification.

Label: FDA Product Code
Description: A three-letter FDA product code identifying a device type; the key most FDA device datasets join on. Its nodes (IRIs ending product-code/<code>) are separate from the FDA Product Classification Record nodes (IRIs ending productcode/<code>); only 443 nodes carry both types, so join the two on the md:productCode literal.

Label: Product Code to NAICS Mapping
Description: A crosswalk assertion that assigns a NAICS industry to an FDA product code, recording the method, source, confidence, review status, and justification of the assignment. The mappings are inferred by the knowledge graph's builders and are not supplied by FDA.

Label: Recall
Description: A recall event summarised on a TPLC product-code record, giving its class and date.

Label: Device Recall Record
Description: A device recall enforcement record from the openFDA recall dataset, with the recalling firm, reason, classification, and distribution. A subclass of FDA Data Record.

Label: Recognized Consensus Standard
Description: A voluntary consensus standard recognized by FDA for use in device premarket submissions.

Label: FDA Registration and Listing Record
Description: An establishment registration and device listing record, giving the registered facility, its status, and its registration number. A subclass of FDA Data Record. The 9,120 records with a geocoded address are also typed md:Facility.

Label: Regulation Number
Description: A 21 CFR regulation number under which a device type is classified.

Label: TPLC Device Record
Description: A Total Product Life Cycle record, aggregating device problems, patient outcomes, MDR trends, and recalls for one FDA product code. A subclass of FDA Data Record.

Label: X-Ray Assembler Record
Description: An FDA x-ray assembler report recording the installation of diagnostic x-ray equipment at a named site.

Label: Feature
Description: A GeoSPARQL feature, a thing that can have a spatial location; here a second type on every geocoded facility (md:Facility).

Label: Geometry
Description: A coherent set of direct positions in space (GeoSPARQL); here the point geometry of a geocoded facility, read through geo:asWKT.

Label: has NAICS classification
Description: Links a manufacturer or an FDA product classification record to its NAICS industry. 10,432 of the 53,499 manufacturers carry between one and nine industries, and 1,589 classification records carry one. The links sit on the classification-record nodes (IRIs ending productcode/<code>) and on the 132 of them that are also typed FDA Product Code. md:hasProductCode mostly leads to the separate product-code/<code> nodes, which have no NAICS link (no 510(k) record reaches one that way), so join submissions to a NAICS industry on the md:productCode literal. The assignments are inferred by the knowledge graph's crosswalk and are not supplied by FDA.
